project: 国色长卷 · 数字牡丹赋
note: Prompts are original production briefs. The research report documents evaluation and subsequent composition, motion, and interaction decisions. No reference website images, code, or music were copied into these assets. Runtime WebP encoding keeps the original dimensions and alpha.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original panoramic background layer for an interactive Chinese peony art exhibition website, titled 国色长卷. Create a museum-quality contemporary Chinese shanshui ink and mineral-pigment painting on warm off-white xuan paper. Wide landscape 16:9. A poetic, quietly radiant spring river valley: pale celadon layered mountains dissolving into spacious pearl-ivory mist, a small elegantly painted Tang-inspired garden pavilion and distant riverside roofs on the far right, fine delicate pine silhouettes, a calm reflective river across the lower quarter. Hand-painted expressive wet ink edges, restrained malachite and azurite wash, a little warm ochre sunlight, visible paper fibres and generous unpainted paper. The left half and upper center must remain mostly beautiful empty ivory mist for large live website typography, the main detailed landforms cluster on the right and along the bottom edge. Sophisticated elegant atmospheric art direction, authentic traditional Chinese painting brushwork meeting modern editorial exhibition design, calm and immersive, subtle depth. This is ONLY the distant environment layer: do not include peony flowers, foreground branches, people, typography, letters, seals, borders, UI or watermarks. Avoid photorealism, 3D-render appearance, saturated fantasy orange sky, generic game art and busy all-over detail. Generate 16:9 landscape at high resolution.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent foreground botanical illustration layer for an original Chinese peony digital art exhibition. Paint a magnificent asymmetrical spray of Chinese tree peonies in the traditional gongbi and mogu ink/mineral-pigment tradition, NOT a photograph. Three large intricately layered peony blossoms: one deep cinnabar/crimson flower facing the viewer near upper center, one elegant blush pink and ivory blossom in three-quarter view to the left, one smaller crimson half-open bud to the upper right. Graceful dark woody stems curve upward from the lower right, delicate nuanced malachite/olive green compound leaves, tiny ochre-gold stamens. Expressive hand-painted watercolour gradients and fine ink contour work, natural irregular petals, luminous softly aged silk/paper pigment quality. Refined imperial botanical painting, poetic rather than decorative clipart. Composition forms a tall open diagonal from bottom-right to upper-left, with an airy silhouette and intentional gaps between leaf clusters. All plant parts isolated on genuinely transparent background, precise soft painted alpha edges, no white rectangles or shadows. No landscape, no vase, no butterflies, no text, no seals, no framing, no watermark, no artificial glossy/3D look. Landscape-ish asset with full silhouette inside frame and a little transparent breathing room.

Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: transparent brush-calligraphy title artwork for an original Chinese art exhibition website. Write EXACTLY these FOUR Chinese characters in a single horizontal line, in correct order: “国色长卷”. Make the calligraphy artistically excellent, strong and flowing expressive Chinese running-script brushwork, confidently thick and thin strokes with authentic dry brush texture and connected movement, readable recognizable characters. Use deep muted cinnabar ink (#8c302c), with tiny subtle dark-ink variations and dry feathered brush edges. Museum-quality contemporary interpretation of Chinese calligraphy, quiet dignity, no glossy gold, no sparkles. The four characters should be similar in visual size, evenly occupying the horizontal composition, not stacked. True transparent background with no coloured haze, no paper texture, no shadows. No other characters, no English, no seal, no additional ornament, no border. Generous transparent padding around all calligraphy so no stroke is cut off. Wide 3:1 horizontal composition.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a separate transparent near-foreground layer for an original Chinese peony digital art website. A very graceful sparse curving peony branch enters from the LOWER LEFT corner and grows diagonally toward the center: two half-open ivory and pale blush tree peonies, a few small closed blush buds, finely articulated sage and dark malachite leaves, a slim ink-brown woody branch with dry-brush details. Traditional Chinese gongbi/mogu botanical painting on silk aesthetic with delicate mineral colours, fine ink outlines and translucent hand-painted washes. Deliberately airy minimal composition and asymmetrical negative space. The blossoms face inward toward the upper right. Elegant, naturally irregular, refined small botanical study; no roses, no cherry blossoms. True transparent background; all empty space fully alpha transparent, no coloured haze, no background gradient, no paper rectangle. Plant silhouette isolated, no cast shadows. No vase, landscape, people, insects, typography, text, border or watermark. Full branch contained in the frame, wide horizontal aspect.
